title: Fortified Optimized & Obvious (FOO)
description: This Mod pack makes Forge "Super" Optimized.
body:
# What the modpack adds

This Modpack aims for a Complete "OPTIMIZE" for 1.20.1 which has the Most mods to date on Modrinth making it simple and effective for playing with mods.

This Modpack Makes it so you can have a fun experience without it being laggy and making your computer run like a complete potato. Here are the main improvments for this compared to other modpacks,

# Preformance for Forge
This great for reducing lag and makes your game run 2x smoother. Heres a good pic of the preformance of a superflat world with this Modpack
![Fps On Superflat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd10ab6a35cc40637a4027789e9927910421c6cd.png)

# Obvious Compatibility
Since this is 1.20.1, you can pretty much add any mod you want only at the expense of future minecraft updates which can already be fixed with backports making this the obvious pick.

#Shaders
The is perfect optimization if you want run potato to highend shaders, Lots to choose from like complementary and bsl shaders.

Note* [not all shaders work from my testing, but theres not the many that dont work, just keep in mind]

# Chunk preloading
You can preload chunks so when you move around, so its not laggy, using the chunky plugin by pop4959: [ https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky ]
